title: COMPUTE-GH-FIRST: compute review recommendation
note: Route research units to GitHub runners by default; make the trainer SSH route explicit and non-colliding (tag runner vs needs_trainer_data, read why 4 of 11 research-script-run-trainer runs failed, keep them off the cycle/sweep windows). Source: docs/plans/COMPUTE-ARCH-REVIEW-2026-10-13.md (ranked recommendations). [2026-10-13 RESEARCH-ROUTER lane] CAUSE OF THE FAILED TRAINER RUNS, READ FROM THE FIELD (comms/research/<unit>/<run>/run-manifest.json on main): runs 38336079476 (RQ-20261012-75b2-20) and 38353918962 (75b2-21) each show cmd 0 exit=None timed_out=true seconds=2700 = the units' own timeout_minutes 45 killed an ml_bakeoff on the 1-OCPU trainer; 38329024424 (75b2-19) has the same ~45 min signature (manifest not collected). 38258786887 (41 s) was a producer bug (off-VM env), already fixed in pm_surprise_eval.py. NOT shown: whether the bake-offs were slow because they ran inside the 00:05Z cycle/04:00Z sweep windows or are simply >45 min of CPU on 1 OCPU -- cmd-0.log not read. SECOND DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED: the trainer SSH step ran under GitHub's default bash -e (set -uo pipefail does not clear -e), so a non-zero ssh skipped the rc= output and the tail of /tmp/out.txt (summary showed '(rc=)') -- that is why the cause stayed unread. Fixed with set +e (PR in flight). ROUTING: compute classes make the choice explicit (needs_vm_data -> trainer, max_concurrent 1; everything else -> runner), so GitHub runners are the default. Closes (state landed_unproven) when the next trainer failure prints its rc and trainer output in the job log.
